instruction: Set up my Bluetooth headphones to automatically connect when powered on.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because the VM environment does not have Bluetooth hardware capabilities, and pairing/connecting external Bluetooth devices cannot be tested or verified.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - requires physical Bluetooth hardware and adapter not available in VM environment
The infeasible() evaluator function is the appropriate choice for hardware-dependent tasks that cannot be executed in the test environment
Metadata explanation clearly documents why the task cannot be verified (lacks Bluetooth hardware capabilities)
No verification logic is needed since the task cannot be executed in the first place
